errors.text: The formula ActionLivePropE at line 32, col 5 to line 32, col 17 of module ActionLevelProp is an action-level formula (i.e., it contains no temporal operators). Only temporal-level (or state-level) formulas are allowed under PROPERTY or PROPERTIES. To check that infinitely many ActionLivePropE steps occur, define a temporal property by applying the "always eventually" temporal operator combination ([]<>) to the formula at line 32, col 5 to line 32, col 17 of module ActionLevelProp (compare page 91 of Specifying Systems at https://lamport.azurewebsites.net/tla/book.html).
